faq_add.q: Cold saw or abrasive cut-off saw?
faq_add.a: A cold saw cuts with a toothed HSS or carbide blade at low speed: a square, burr-free cut that is ready to weld, no sparks and no heat in the part, but the blade must suit the material. An abrasive saw grinds through with a 12 – 16″ wheel at high speed: a lower price, any steel including hardened, but a hot part, sparks, a burr and wheels that wear quickly. For production cutting of tube and profiles choose a cold saw; for occasional cutting of mixed steel the abrasive saw.

set.hero_brand_line: ISITAN circular cold saws are made in Turkey by ISITAN Makine, the CT325 in Taiwan by CSM and the automatic BMDO saws by Bekamak Makina, Turkey; NovoTech's value-line cold saws are built in China to NovoTech's specification. All sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.
